name: Space Tables Inc
old_description: Space Tables is a family owned company. To us, the table is the heart of every home. Whether that home is a private residence or an assisted living facility, the table is where people come together to share a meal, share their time, and share their lives.
about:
Space Tables Inc is based in Maple Grove, Minnesota. The company traces its roots to 1976, when it was founded as a family-owned business. In 1977, the firm developed one of the first wheelchair-accessible patio tables; a customer's suggestion to focus on healthcare shaped its direction. Today it operates as a woman-owned enterprise.

The company manufactures commercial and institutional dining tables for indoor and outdoor use. Its capabilities include table base fabrication with steel columns and stamped steel legs, zinc undercoat finishes, and outdoor powder coating. Product lines encompass the Orlando Collection, Sanibel Series, Vegas Collection, and Cheyenne Series, all offered with customizable finishes and height-adjustable mechanisms.

Space Tables serves senior living communities, assisted living facilities, healthcare providers, and restaurants. Its tables are designed to support independence for residents in home care and nursing home settings, and to withstand the demands of commercial dining environments.

The company's stated mission centers on the belief that dining is a vital social event. By offering customizable, durable tables that can be raised, lowered, and moved, Space Tables aims to help caregivers provide better care and to create products that last for years without replacement.
